notes.title: Customization for all frogs!
notes.content:
This last weekend some of our amazing playtesters had the opportunity to see for the first time what customization options are available for the frogs.

We are really happy with how each player could personalize their frog, look unique, express themselves, and be differentiable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459764/1dc4415d6972e60322594d74a7fd4004167563b4.gif[/img]

[h1]Simplicity is key[/h1]
Each different personalization option is divided into two categories: [b]patterns[/b] and [b]colors[/b]. You can customize the two of them independently, allowing a lot of customization options, even when using the same pattern or the same colors.

[h1]The Throng is coming [i]really[/i] soon![/h1]
We will be writing more devlogs as the release date gets closer, so remember to wishlist [b]The Throng[/b] and join [url=https://discord.gg/xdSBc4F2q4]the official Discord server[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3424870/The_Throng/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=prerelease&utm_term=devlog1

Thank you!
SoGon Games
